entry.title: New: dsh-web-startup-auth
entry.summary: Replaces the dsh web startup to allow binding 0.0.0.0, gated by username/password login: signed session cookies, /api route protection, an auth tab in the settings panel, and a reset CLI that rotates the signing key to invalidate all sessions. Exact install spec: github:gdwhisper/dsh-web-startup-auth. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
